form.narrative: Collided with a divider after swerving to avoid a pedestrian.

photo.description: The rear bumper of the vehicle shows a moderate dent.
photo.summary: This image shows the rear of a maroon Ford Mondeo car with visible damage on the bumper. The car is parked in a parking lot alongside other vehicles. The license plate is partially visible with the letter "E" discernible. The rear window displays a sticker indicating an "Intelligent Protection System." The Ford logo is prominently displayed below the window. The car's model name, "MONDEO," is printed on the tailgate.
